provenance: Provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]
viewing: no image was written for viewing, opened or displayed; no CT data was read in PHASE 1; preview_*.png files of the HF repos were never downloaded

sources.hf_card_and_code: verbatim copies kept outside the repo (/work/cards; they carry personal names and links); fetched by tools/sib/ckpt-screen-b/fetch.py cards, git blob oids equal to catalogue; sha256 per checkpoint in card_files_sha256

architecture: ResNet3D-50 (Kinetics-700 r3d50_KM_200ep init, conv1 summed to 1 channel) + per-stage torch.max over z + 2-D U-Net decoder; 83,317,825 parameters; all six share modeling_inkdetection.py (git oid c75143f2...) and configuration_inkdetection.py

input_spec_common.tensor: (B, 1, D=62, H=256, W=256) float32 (config.json input_depth 62, input_size 256; modeling docstring)
input_spec_common.dtype_source: uint8 surface-volume layers (card tiling snippet: "(H, W, D) uint8 stack of the 62 layers")
input_spec_common.normalisation: clip(0, 200) then /255 (card training text: "clipped raw uint8 layers to [0, 200] then applied Normalize(mean=0, std=1)"; villa train_resnet3d_lib data_ops.py np.clip(.., 0, 200) and config.py A.Normalize(mean=[0]*in_chans, std=[1]*in_chans), albumentations max_pixel_value 255). DISCREPANCIES: modeling docstring says "z-score normalised"; the card tiling snippet feeds raw 0..255 floats without clip or /255. Resolved by the weights: see bn1_input_scale.

voxel_size.card: UNKNOWN (not stated in card, config or modeling code)
voxel_size.code: ~2 um class: villa deprecated/ink-detection/metadata.json dataset_name "2um_dataset" ("Collection of 2um resolution segments"), which lists all four iteration-0 training segments; train_resnet3d_3d_decoder.py maps l_2 to base_path "2um_dataset/s4_2um". Exact per-segment voxel size is not documented.
voxel_size.why_2399: the 2 um-class spacing of the DEV scrolls (dev_registry voxel_um_2 = 2.399 for PHerc0139 and PHerc0814); an assumption inside the documented class, flagged

input_spec_common.slices: 62 consecutive layers at 1 layer = 1 voxel spacing, centred crop of the segment layer range (villa _compute_selected_layer_indices / vesuvius select_layer_indices); organizer surface volumes use layer_range [1, 63) i.e. layers 1..62 around the surface layer ~32 (metadata.json)

orientation_order.documented: per training segment: l_2 reverse_layers False (inference_resnet3d_3d_decoder.py segments_to_infer ('l_2', False, '2um_dataset/s4_2um')); 500p2a and 658 reverse_layers True; 9b segments False (metadata.json, train_resnet3d_3d_decoder.py); iteration-0 card: "l_2 inference uses reverse_layers=True to match the training-segment convention"
orientation_order.relative_to_devloop_render: UNDOCUMENTED: no card or code relates organizer layer order to the devloop vc_render_tifxyz -n 31 --flip-normals slice order, so both orders are mapped and reported (DECL-DEVLOOP-SCREEN item 2) and the order is not chosen from DEV. Documented relation inside the family: iteration-0 text order = reverse of the l_2 native order; iterations 1-5 = l_2 native order; i.e. iteration-0 and 1-5 expect OPPOSITE orders on the same input.

tile.output: (B,1,64,64) logits, quarter resolution; sigmoid; F.interpolate x4 bilinear; overlap mean; tiles with any fmask==0 pixel skipped; image padded to multiples of 256
tile.output_format: uint8 = clip(pred*255) truncated (card); wrapper writes the devloop format <wid>.tif (forward) and <wid>_reverse.tif, 2-D uint8, LZW

wrapper_modes.spec: render resampled to 2.399 um in x, y and z (zoom 3.9025; 62 layers = 148.7 um centred on render slice 15; render slices 7.18..22.82 used); map area-averaged back to the 9.362 um grid
wrapper_modes.native: OUT OF SPEC in voxel size: 16 central render slices (7..22, official centre crop, 150 um) fed at 9.362 um; D = 16 instead of 62 (the network is depth-agnostic: max over z per stage)

wrapper.env: python 3.11, torch 2.14.0+cpu, transformers 4.57.6 (config transformers_version; 5.x cannot import the official PreTrainedModel file), safetensors, numpy, opencv-python-headless, tifffile + imagecodecs, zarr<3

cost_estimate_2x2cm.assumptions: 4 threads, fp32, batch 1, torch CPU; every tile valid (holes only lower the count); wall minutes on this 4-vCPU container = the figures (all 4 threads used); per-tile seconds measured in smoke.json (spec = 62 layers, native = 16 layers)

open_decisions_for_orchestrator: geometry: spec mode (documented ~2 um class, 2.399 um assumed) costs ~394 CPU-min per order per 2x2 cm window (~13 h both orders); native 9.362 um mode ~7 min per order but is out of the documented voxel size (DECL-DEVLOOP-SCREEN item 1 takes the voxel size from card/code)
text order: undocumented relative to the devloop render; iteration-0 and iterations 1-5 are documented to expect opposite orders on the same segment; both orders will be mapped

in-sample: iteration-0 trained on PHerc0009B, PHerc0500P2 and PHerc0343P segments (scroll attribution from villa code): its 0009B/0500P2 DEV windows are UNKNOWN unless certified not same-papyrus; iterations 1-5 (l_2, PHerc1667 only) are out-of-sample for every DEV scroll
normalisation: clip(0,200)/255 (training text, villa code, bn1 statistics) instead of the card snippet raw 0..255 input
